author: CBR
description:
Atlus' 2024 JRPG masterpiece is getting a Nintendo Switch 2 port making it so even more players can experience the game. Whether you've played it before or if this is your first time jumping in, we think that the Switch 2 version is a great place to experience the game, albeit with a couple minor hiccups.
